briefdescription.para: Standalone action registry with key dispatch and prefix state machine.

detaileddescription.para: action::Registry is the single owner of all user-performable actions in END. It holds a fixed action table (entries never change after construction), a key map rebuilt on every config reload, and the prefix state machine previously implemented in ModalKeyBinding.

listitem.para: Caller registers every action via registerAction().
buildKeyMap() is called after registration, with binding data from lua::Engine.
If handleKeyPress() returns true the key is consumed; otherwise the caller forwards it to the PTY.
If in waiting state: look up key in modal bindings → execute → idle.
If in idle state and key equals the prefix key: enter waiting state.
If in idle state: look up key in global bindings → execute.

simplesect.para: All methods must be called on the MESSAGE THREAD.
